captions.caption: A high-angle shot shows three inflatable military boats with soldiers speeding across the water.
A single inflatable boat filled with soldiers moves quickly across the water near a coastline.
A second inflatable boat appears, following the first one across the water.
Two inflatable military boats travel side-by-side at high speed.
The two boats continue in parallel, with soldiers visible holding weapons.
The camera follows the two boats as they move across the water with a hilly coast in the background.
Soldiers in two inflatable boats speed along the shoreline of a large landmass.
The two boats continue moving in formation, approaching a sandy beach.
The two inflatable boats get closer to the shore, preparing to land.
As the boats near the beach, their wakes disturb the shallow water.
One of the inflatable boats begins to slow down as it reaches the sandy beach.
The lead boat comes to a stop on the sand, while the other is no longer visible.
Soldiers in the landed boat prepare to disembark onto the beach.
The soldiers from the boat take up positions on the sandy beach.
A wide shot shows a large-scale amphibious exercise with numerous boats and vehicles on the water.
A military patrol boat is in the foreground, with amphibious assault vehicles and other ships behind it.
The patrol boat moves across the frame, leading a fleet of military watercraft.
The camera pans to follow the patrol boat, revealing more amphibious vehicles in the background.
The naval fleet moves across the water, with a large ship visible in the distant haze.
The patrol boat continues its path, with multiple amphibious vehicles creating wakes.
The camera focuses on the patrol boat as a large naval ship looms on the horizon.
A red flag on a pole appears on the shore in the foreground as the naval exercise continues.
The patrol boat moves further away, with the large ship in the background becoming clearer.
The camera holds a steady shot of the naval vessels moving across the sea.
The patrol boat continues its course, now further to the left of the frame.
A wide view captures the patrol boat and several amphibious vehicles during the exercise.
The patrol boat moves out of frame to the left, while the red flag waves on the shore.
A new shot shows two amphibious assault vehicles moving in parallel across the water.
The two amphibious vehicles travel at speed, creating large wakes behind them.
The amphibious vehicles are seen from a distance, with large, hazy mountains in the background.
The camera holds a steady shot on the two amphibious vehicles moving in formation.
The two vehicles continue their path across the turquoise water.
The wide shot of the two amphibious vehicles against the mountainous backdrop continues.
The amphibious vehicle on the right is slightly ahead of the one on the left.
The two military vehicles continue to move steadily across the water.
The camera remains focused on the two amphibious assault vehicles in the distance.
A new shot shows multiple amphibious assault vehicles approaching the shore.
An amphibious vehicle in the foreground moves towards the camera, with others in the background.
The lead amphibious vehicle creates a large wake as it powers through the choppy waves.
A large naval vessel is visible on the distant horizon behind the approaching vehicles.
The camera follows the group of amphibious vehicles as they make their way towards the beach.
The lead vehicle continues its approach, with a hilly island visible in the background.
The amphibious vehicles navigate through the waves in the choppy sea.
The shot remains focused on the amphibious landing exercise, with a helicopter appearing in the distance.
A helicopter is visible in the upper left of the frame, flying over the water.
The amphibious assault vehicles continue their steady advance towards the shore.
The camera holds a steady view of the amphibious landing exercise in progress.
The lead amphibious vehicle gets closer to the viewer's perspective on the shore.
A new wide shot shows two inflatable boats moving away from the shore toward a fleet of ships.
The two boats speed across the water, leaving white trails behind them.
Several large naval vessels, including a surfaced submarine, are visible on the horizon.
The two small inflatable boats continue moving in parallel across the sea.
The camera holds a wide shot of the two boats with the distant naval fleet in the background.
The boats are the primary moving elements in the wide, static shot.
The scene portrays the vastness of the ocean with the military fleet in the background.
The two inflatable boats continue their journey across the calm water.
The camera remains steady, capturing the wide expanse of the sea and sky.
The boats become smaller in the frame as they travel further away from the camera.
The scene continues to show the boats moving steadily towards the distant ships.
The final shot shows the two small boats against the backdrop of the large naval fleet on the horizon.
